secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (find in your Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API, or in .env.production)

secrets.name: VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon/publishable key (find in your Supabase dashboard > Project Settings > API, or in .env.production)

secrets.name: VITE_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name (find in your Cloudinary dashboard → Settings → Cloud name)

secrets.name: VITE_CLOUDINARY_UPLOAD_PRESET
secrets.description: Cloudinary unsigned upload preset (create in Cloudinary dashboard → Settings → Upload → Upload presets, set mode to Unsigned)
